subject.title: fix(cron): honor explicit announce delivery on system-event jobs

question: Should an unpinned `systemEvent` with a targeted announce delivery request remain invalid, or should OpenClaw formally support it by converting it into an isolated agent turn?
rationale: The patch is not a narrow correction to an established output contract: it accepts an input that currently fails validation and changes it from a main-session system event to isolated model execution.

options.title: Keep the current rejection
options.body: Preserve the existing validation until a broader cron delivery contract specifies how system-event delivery should behave.

options.title: Adopt isolated delivery semantics
options.body: Accept this behavior only after documenting the session, agent-turn, and delivery guarantees and adding real execution proof.

recommendation.title: Keep the current rejection
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing validation until a broader cron delivery contract specifies how system-event delivery should behave.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only concrete contributor connected to the proposed implementation in the supplied review context; current-main area ownership needs a history pass before a stronger routing claim.
